race.title: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Novices' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: SLEDGEHAMMER had a next-time-out winner behind him at Wetherby and is taken to defy the handicapper again and make it 3-3 since joining Adrian Keatley. Bells of Ufford made a promising start to his chasing career at Ffos Las and is second choice ahead of Kastellion and Could Be You . SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE) BELLS OF UFFORD (IRE) KASTELLION (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Sledgehammer (7/4), Could Be You (4/1), Danger Nap (5/1), Peckforton Hills (6/1), Kastellion (8/1), Bells Of Ufford (8/1), Vicomte Le Brave (33/1), Scoro (33/1), Illico De Montave (33/1)
